raw.title: Sales Development Representative
raw.excerpt: Hello.  We’re Teya. Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.
raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your mission

Open the door to new customer opportunities, while owning both your results and your earning potential.

You’ll identify and engage businesses with complex needs, understand how they operate, and decide when an opportunity is ready for deeper commercial discussion. Your role is to ensure our Key Account Managers spend their time with the right customers, at the right moment, with the right context.

You’ll own the quality of the pipeline you create and your contribution to conversion. This is a high-standards role built around clear targets, fair commission, and progression over time.

What will you be doing?

  • Proactively reaching out to prospective merchants with complex needs

  • Running focused, consultative discovery conversations

  • Understanding business models, priorities, and growth plans

  • Qualifying opportunities against clear criteria

  • Booking high-quality meetings for Key Account Managers

  • Preparing clear, structured handovers in CRM

  • Managing follow-ups and prioritisation with discipline

  • Collaborating closely with Key Account Managers on target accounts

  • Sharing insight to support account strategy and conversion

Your story

You’ll be expected to balance curiosity with commercial judgement, and take pride in the quality of opportunities you pass on. To succeed in this role, we’re looking for someone with:

You will be expected to make a high volume of outbound calls daily as part of a target-driven sales environment.

  • Proven experience in sales development, inside sales, or outbound sales roles

  • Confidence engaging business owners and senior stakeholders

  • A consultative approach, you ask thoughtful questions and listen carefully

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly in qualification and handovers

  • Comfort working towards activity and conversion targets

  • Strong organisation and prioritisation skills

  • Comfort working with autonomy, supported by clear expectations, coaching, and feedback

  • Ambition to grow, motivated by a role that builds credibility, earning potential, and long-term career options

  • Strong organisation and pipeline management skills

  • Comfort working with autonomy, alongside clear expectations, coaching, and feedback

  • Ambition to grow, motivated by a role where consistent performance is recognised, rewarded, and can open doors across the business

The Perks

  • On top of your basic salary, you will be able to earn uncapped commission with typical on-target earnings of £60,000 - £70,0000 in your first year

  • Thorough onboarding and training

  • 25 days of Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

  • Clearly defined career progression ladder and growth opportunities within the business

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with Wellhub, 1-1 therapy sessions, meditation sessions and access to digital fitness and nutrition apps

  • Extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices

  • Private Medical and Life Insurance

  • Pension Scheme

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for an Auto Insurance Product Manager to join our team. Family-owned, UAIC, is one of the largest privately held property and casualty insurance companies in the United States. The key to our growth and success is a commitment to providing quality service to our agents and customers, by providing disciplined underwriting, and strategic claims handling. Our ongoing efforts to invest substantial resources in personnel and technology are the foundation of our promise of assuring maximum efficiency and specialized operations in the industry. We are proud that our independent agents and customers have recognized our dedication by making UAIC the market leader in every state where we conduct business.

We’re hiring an Personal Lines Auto Insurance Product Manager to support our Texas, Arizona & Indiana auto insurance business. This role will help lead product strategy, execution, and performance in alignment with State-specific regulatory and market dynamics. You must have experience in auto insurance, and Texas, Arizona & Indiana market knowledge is required. Non-standard auto experience is a plus.

This is a fully Remote Opportunity with quarterly travel to Miami for collaboration #remote

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and manage auto insurance products specific to Texas, Arizona & Indianna
  • Ensure compliance with Texas, Arizona & Indiana DOI regulations and filings.
  • Drive product performance through analysis and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Identify competitive advantages through research and market data.
  • Support rate filings, form updates, and documentation accuracy.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Personal Lines Auto Insurance product development or product management.
  • Working knowledge of Personal Lines Auto P&C insurance regulations.
  • Strong knowledge of state insurance statutes, regulations, case law, policy contract interpretation, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience reviewing insurance policy forms, endorsements, and coverage language for legal and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience preparing and managing SERFF filings and working directly with state insurance departments (preferred), including TDI, FLOIR, and other state DOIs.
  • Background in auto insurance; non-standard auto experience preferred.
  • Strong analytical, data interpretation, project management, and communication skills.
BENEFITS:
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match.
  • Comprehensive Medical, Prescription Drug, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Leave programs.
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Basic Life Insurance and Voluntary Life/ADD
  • Short Term and Long-Term Disability
UAIC participates in the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information about E-Verify, please visit .

UAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees. All employment decisions at UAIC are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

raw.title: Partner Implementation Specialist (Health Tech)
raw.excerpt: Who We AreWe are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company that leverages innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability in elective medicine.
raw.description:
Who We Are

We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company that leverages innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability in elective medicine. Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming our industry.

This job requires up to 50% travel throughout the US. Candidates should live within an hour to a major airport.

While we are a remote-first company, we are currently only able to hire candidates located in the following U.S. states: CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, OK, OR, PA, RI, TX, UT, and WA. We hope to expand to additional states in the future.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly organized and tech-savvy Implementation Specialist to lead the onboarding of clinics onto the Adoreal platform. This role involves project management, coordination across internal and clinic teams, and hands-on support with software setup, workflow digitization, data migration, and training. You will serve as the primary point of contact for clinics, ensuring a seamless and structured implementation process.

Responsibilities

Project Management & Coordination

  • Serve as the main liaison between Adoreal and the clinic during onboarding.
  • Facilitate data migration from the clinic’s existing systems in collaboration with technical teams.
  • Organize and structure clinic data to align with Adoreal’s analytics framework and standards.

Software Setup and Data Migration

  • Support the implementation and configuration of Adoreal’s EMR and CRM systems.
  • Manage project timelines and track key milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate efforts across internal teams (technical, CRM, training) and clinic stakeholders.
  • Identify potential risks, communicate status updates, and resolve issues efficiently.

Training & Support

  • Provide training and onboarding support to clinic staff, ensuring smooth adoption of systems.
  • Develop and deliver onboarding documentation, training guides, and resource materials.
  • Monitor post-go-live adoption and address ongoing support needs.

Candidate Profile

Experience & Background

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in healthcare onboarding, software implementation, or project coordination.
  • Hands-on experience with EMR systems and CRM platforms in a healthcare or clinical setting.
  • Demonstrated success in managing multiple onboarding or implementation projects.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
  • Technical fluency with EMR/CRM systems, data migration, and digital workflow tools.
  • Ability to clearly communicate and guide clinic stakeholders through new system adoption.
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and solutions-focused approach.

Requirements

Qualifications

    • Minimum 7 years of experience in healthcare onboarding, software implementation, or project coordination, ideally with a small or growing EMR/EHR company (not enterprise/hospital-system software).
    • Hands-on experience implementing and supporting EMR systems and CRM platforms in an ambulatory or outpatient clinical setting (e.g., private practices, specialty clinics)
    • Demonstrated success independently managing multiple onboarding or implementation projects, ideally within a small, lean team where you owned the process end-to-end rather than following an established enterprise playbook.
    • Deep familiarity with ambulatory healthcare workflows, including patient intake, documentation, payment processing/billing, scheduling, and HIPAA compliance.
    • Experience training clinical and administrative staff in outpatient/ambulatory environments, including independently building your own training materials, guides, or documentation from scratch (not relying on a pre-built corporate training program).
    • Ensures implementations align with legal and regulatory requirements, especially around data handling and access control.

Benefits

What We Offer

At Adoreal, we believe in supporting our team’s well-being and growth through comprehensive benefits and a collaborative, people-first culture. As a globally remote company, we prioritize flexibility, inclusivity, and teamwork rooted in the Adoreal principles.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Healthcare coverage for you and your family
  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Performance-based bonuses and company equity opportunities
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible schedules
  • Collaborative and thriving team culture guided by Adoreal’s core values

Why Adoreal?

Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. Promotions and growth opportunities are limitless, driven only by your performance and dedication to our core principles:

  • We do what is best for the company, not what is best for individuals of the company—we take pride in our work, but not in pride itself—the success of Adoreal is more important than our egos.
  • We always share relevant information and admit our mistakes freely and openly (even when it is worrisome or uncomfortable to do so). Candid communication and a solution-oriented mindset is rewarded.
  • We innovate by finding the right problems, then solving them. We thrive on change that minimizes complexity and improves situations for our stakeholders.
  • We incentivize efficient results & people over process and focus only on the work that creates the most value for our stakeholders.
  • We are quietly confident and openly humble, being tenacious in our quest to perform and inspire others with our thirst for excellence.
  • We do not bow up and knock down—we care about our teammates and treat all of them with respect, regardless of their level within the company.
  • We are steadfast in our pursuit to better our company, our colleagues, and ourselves. When we hire, we only hire people who bleed our principles and who will hopefully be our replacement one day.

At this time, Adoreal is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must have current and valid authorization to work in the country where they are applying. We comply with all applicable employment and immigration laws, including U.S. regulations, and encourage applicants to verify their work authorization status before applying.  

Adoreal is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and fair workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable U.S. law (EEOC) or local employment regulations where we operate. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
Accommodations for disabilities are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.

*We are not working with search firms for this role, thank you*

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Adoreal has become aware of fraudulent job offers being sent by people falsely claiming to represent us. To protect yourself:

  • Verify the sender's email address matches our official domain before responding.
  • Be cautious of offers that come with no prior application or interview process.
  • Never share personal details, banking information, or Social Security numbers as part of a job offer or interview.
  • Legitimate offers will never ask you to pay money upfront for equipment, training, or onboarding.
  • If something feels off — urgency, poor grammar, unusual payment requests — trust your instincts and pause before responding.

If you receive a suspicious email or offer claiming to be from Adoreal, please don't respond to it directly. Report it as spam through your email provider and reach out to us at with any concerns.

raw.title: Storyous Marketing Specialist
raw.excerpt: ✔️ Baví tě marketing, gastro a chceš tvořit obsah, který má reálný dopad?
raw.description:
✔️ Baví tě marketing, gastro a chceš tvořit obsah, který má reálný dopad?

✔️ Láká tě role, kde můžeš kombinovat strategii a exekuci, přicházet s vlastními nápady a zároveň nebýt jen za počítačem, ale chodit mezi lidi, navštěvovat gastro podniky a tvořit obsah přímo u našich klientů? 🍰💛

👉 Do Storyous hledáme Marketing Specialistu/ku, který/á bude rozvíjet naši značku na českém trhu.

Kdo jsme

Storyous je moderní pokladní systém pro gastro podniky a součást mezinárodní fintech skupiny Teya.

Díky propojení Storyous POS a platebních terminálů Teya nabízíme podnikům kompletní řešení v jednom zařízení – od obsluhy hostů přes přehled o provozu až po moderní platební technologie. 💯

Pomáháme zkrátka restauracím, barům a kavárnám zjednodušit provoz, platby i každodenní řízení podniku, aby se mohly soustředit na to nejdůležitější: své zákazníky a skvělý servis. 🙌🏽

Na trhu jsme víc než 12 let a patříme mezi zavedené značky se silnou pozicí v gastro segmentu a funkčním produktem. Nebudeš začínat od nuly, ale zároveň dostaneš velký prostor značku dál posouvat, posilovat její lokální relevanci a přinášet marketing, který je blízko skutečnému životu českého gastra.

Tahle pozice je ideální pro někoho, kdo:

  • chce mít reálný vliv na to, jak značka Storyous v Česku vypadá a jak roste

  • má rád/a kreativitu, rozmanitost a práci v terénu

  • nechce řešit jen exekuci, ale chce přicházet i s vlastními nápady

  • baví ho/ji gastro prostředí a práce s lidmi

👉 Nebudeš na to sám/sama – úzce budeš spolupracovat se zbytkem marketingového týmu, obchodem i dalšími kolegy napříč firmou. Lokální exekuce, obsah a ownership ale budou ve velké míře ve tvých rukou.

Co budeš dělat:

  • připravovat a realizovat lokální marketingové aktivity pro český trh

  • vymýšlet, tvořit a adaptovat obsah pro sociální sítě, kampaně a další marketingové výstupy

  • připravovat jednoduché grafické výstupy pro sociální sítě, kampaně a další marketingové materiály

  • navštěvovat gastro podniky, fotit, natáčet a sbírat příběhy našich klientů

  • spolupracovat s obchodním týmem na lokálních aktivitách, kampaních a podpoře akvizice

  • podílet se na eventech, partnerstvích a aktivitách spojených s gastro komunitou

  • spolupracovat s širším marketingovým týmem na plánování, prioritách a vyhodnocování výsledků

  • pomáhat budovat značku Storyous tak, aby byla pro český trh relevantní, srozumitelná a viditelná

👉 Není to monotónní práce od stolu. Jeden den můžeš připravovat lokální kampaň, druhý den natáčet obsah u klienta a další den být na eventu nebo koordinovat aktivaci s obchodním týmem.

Co za to dostaneš:

  • 26 dní dovolené + sick days

  • Benefit Plus Cafeteria (2000 Kč měsíčně kredit na sport, kulturu, jídlo apod.)

  • flexibilitu a možnost občasné práce z domova

  • moderní vybavení k práci včetně MacBooku a gear pro tvorbu contentu

  • možnost dělat marketing, který má viditelný dopad na značku i business

  • velkou míru důvěry, samostatnosti a prostoru pro vlastní iniciativu

  • práci v přátelském a pozitivně naladěném týmu

  • palivo k doplnění energie v podobě snacků, čerstvého ovoce i výborné kávy v kanceláři je samozřejmostí:)

Jsi pro nás ten/ta pravý/á, pokud:

  • máš zkušenost alespoň 2-3 roky s marketingem, contentem a social media

  • máš blízko ke gastru – profesně nebo osobně

  • umíš psát a komunikovat plynně česky na úrovni rodilého mluvčího

  • angličtinu ovládáš alespoň na úrovni B2, protože je to náš interní firemní jazyk

  • jsi samostatný/á, spolehlivý/á a umíš si organizovat práci

  • nebojíš se přijít s vlastním názorem a novými nápady

  • baví tě kombinace kreativní práce a exekuce v terénu

  • zvládáš základní práci s běžnými marketingovými nástroji a reportingem

  • zvládáš připravit jednoduché grafické výstupy v některém z běžných nástrojů jako Canva, Figma nebo Adobe Express

👉 Nemusíš umět všechno od prvního dne. Důležitý je pro nás přístup, chuť učit se a schopnost převzít odpovědnost za svoji část práce.

Pár praktických informací na závěr:

  • pracovat budeš z kanceláře v Praze – Karlíně (Rohanské nábřeží)

  • práce je na plný úvazek a hlavní pracovní poměr (HPP)

  • nastoupit můžeš ihned nebo dohodou – preferujeme začít co nejdřív

  • součástí role je i práce v terénu, návštěvy podniků a občasné cestování na různé akce a festivaly

Jak bude probíhat výběrko:

  1. Pošli nám své CV, pár vět o sobě a klidně i portfolio – zajímá nás, na čem jsi pracoval/a, jaký obsah jsi tvořil/a a jaké projekty nebo kanály jsi měl/a na starosti.

  2. Ozve se ti naše recruiterka Lenka a dáte si úvodní call, kde se poznáte a řeknete si víc o roli i o tobě.

  3. Pokud si budeme sedět, čeká tě krátký domácí úkol, na kterém nám ukážeš, jak nad marketingem, obsahem a značkou přemýšlíš v praxi.

  4. Následovat pak bude i osobní setkání s Katy (Storyous Marketing Leader), se kterou společně projdete vypracování úkolu, popovídáte si o tvých zkušenostech a přístupu k marketingu obecně a zodpoví ti všechny zbývající otázky k roli nebo týmu.

✅ Zní to jako něco pro tebe?
Dej nám o sobě vědět, moc rádi tě poznáme!

raw.description:
Horizon Usher Foundation recherche un(e) Responsable Communication & Fundraising passionné(e), créatif(ve) et force de proposition pour accompagner le développement de la fondation.

En lien direct avec le fondateur, vous serez chargé(e) de développer la visibilité de la fondation, animer sa communauté, valoriser ses projets, les communiquer, et mettre en place des campagnes de collecte de fonds afin de soutenir la recherche sur le syndrome d’Usher et la rétinite pigmentaire.

Ce poste offre l'opportunité de participer à la croissance d'une jeune fondation ambitieuse, portée par des projets artistiques, sportifs, humanitaires et scientifiques à dimension internationale.

Vos missions

Communication & contenu

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de communication de la fondation.
  • Gérer les réseaux sociaux (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).
  • Élaborer le calendrier éditorial.
  • Rédiger et publier les contenus (posts, articles, newsletters, communiqués, pages web…).
  • Valoriser les projets, événements et avancées de la fondation à travers un storytelling impactant.
  • Assurer une veille sur l'actualité scientifique liée au syndrome d’Usher et à la rétinite pigmentaire, puis la vulgariser auprès de notre communauté (quelqu'un s'occupe déjà de la pêche aux infos; il faudra centraliser les informations et les communiquer sur les réseaux sociaux et site internet)
  • Mettre à jour le site internet et les supports de communication.
  • Suivre les performances des contenus et proposer des axes d'amélioration.

Fundraising

  • Concevoir et piloter des campagnes de collecte de fonds.
  • Créer des campagnes d'emailing à destination des donateurs et partenaires.
  • Optimiser les pages de collecte et les appels aux dons.
  • Développer des actions visant à recruter et fidéliser les donateurs.
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et analyser les résultats des campagnes.
  • Être force de proposition pour développer de nouvelles initiatives de financement.

Vos compétences

Qualités rédactionnelles.

Très bonnes capacités de storytelling

Maîtrise des réseaux sociaux et de leurs codes.

Expérience en création de contenu digital.

Connaissance des outils d'emailing (MailPoet).

Bonne organisation, autonomie et sens des priorités.

Créativité et esprit d'initiative.

Sensibilité aux projets à impact, à la santé ou au monde associatif.

Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (écrit et oral).

Seront particulièrement appréciés

  • Expérience dans une ONG, une fondation ou une structure à impact.
  • Expérience en fundraising digital.
  • Connaissance de WordPress et de Canva (ou outils équivalents).
  • Intérêt pour la recherche médicale, le handicap ou les causes d'intérêt général.
  • Expérience dans le développement de communautés et l'analyse des performances digitales.

Avantages

Participer au développement d’une fondation jeune, ambitieuse et en pleine croissance.

Travailler directement avec le fondateur et contribuer aux décisions stratégiques.

Être au cœur de projets internationaux mêlant art, mode, aventure, recherche scientifique et impact social.

Avoir une grande autonomie et la possibilité de proposer et développer ses propres idées.

Construire une expérience forte dans le domaine des projets à impact, de la communication et du fundraising.

Développer un réseau international auprès d’acteurs issus de la mode, des médias, de la recherche, des entreprises et du monde associatif.

Participer à une aventure humaine porteuse de sens, avec un impact concret sur la vie des personnes atteintes de maladies rares de la vision.

Horizon Usher Foundation est une jeune fondation en pleine croissance, portée par une ambition forte et de nombreux projets à développer.

Nous recherchons une personne souhaitant s’investir à temps partiel et participer activement à la construction de la fondation, en apportant ses compétences, sa créativité et ses idées.

Ce poste offre une grande autonomie et la possibilité d’évoluer avec le projet.

Le temps de travail et l’organisation pourront évoluer en fonction du développement de la fondation et des résultats obtenus.

raw.description:
Remote | Freelance | Commission-based

Join our growing team at Next Job Abroad!

Are you an experienced recruitment consultant with a background in agency recruitment? Are you fluent in Italian and passionate about connecting people with exciting international career opportunities?

We're looking for an experienced Italian-speaking International Freelance Recruiter to join our international team and help us recruit candidates for customer service and multilingual roles across Europe.

We're looking for someone who already understands the pace, ownership and expectations of agency recruitment and enjoys building candidate pipelines from scratch.

About the Role

As an Italian-speaking International Freelance Recruiter, you'll manage your own recruitment projects from sourcing through placement while working remotely as part of our international team.

During your first three months, you'll receive a paid onboarding and training period, giving you time to learn our clients, systems and recruitment processes while building your own pipeline.

After the onboarding period, you'll transition to an uncapped commission model, where your earnings are directly linked to your results.

To succeed in this role, you should be willing to dedicate approximately 30–40 hours per week.

Your Responsibilities

  • Source and headhunt Italian-speaking candidates for international positions
  • Recruit candidates in English for multilingual roles across Europe
  • Conduct interviews and assess candidate suitability
  • Present high-quality candidates to our clients
  • Build and manage your own candidate pipeline
  • Maintain excellent communication throughout the recruitment process
  • Collaborate closely with our international recruitment team
  • Follow up with candidates after placement to ensure a smooth onboarding experience

Requirements

Native or near-native Italian and strong English skills

Previous experience working for a recruitment agency is required

Experience managing the full recruitment cycle

Strong sourcing and headhunting skills, particularly using job portals and social media

Comfortable working independently with performance-based targets

Highly organised, proactive and self-motivated

Passionate about candidate experience and quality-driven recruitment

Please note

Applications from candidates without previous agency recruitment experience will unfortunately not be considered for this role.

raw.description:
Hornblower Group is a global leader in experience and transportation. Spanning a 100-year history, Hornblower Group’s portfolio of international offerings includes water- and land-based experiences and ferry and transportation services. City Experiences, Hornblower Group’s premier experience division, offers dining and sightseeing cruises and walking and food tours through the City Cruises, Walks, and Devour brands. City Ferry, part of Hornblower Group’s Ferry and Transportation Division, is the largest private operator of high-speed passenger and vehicle ferries in the United States, carrying more than 10 million passengers annually and operating services including NYC Ferry, Puerto Rico Ferry, and other regional ferry systems. Hornblower Group’s subsidiaries include Hornblower Marine, which provides vessel outhaul and maintenance services at Bridgeport Boatworks in Bridgeport, Connecticut, and Seaward Services, Inc., a full-service shipping, waterfront logistics and management company that specializes in the operation and maintenance of government and commercial vessels. Additionally, Anchor Operating System, LLC, a Hornblower Group subsidiary and independent entity, provides reservation, ticketing and website integration services for clients in the transportation, tourism and entertainment industries. Today, Hornblower Group’s global portfolio covers over 10 countries, over 50 U.S. cities and serves more than 20 million guests annually. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, Hornblower Group’s additional corporate offices reside in San Francisco, California; Boston, Massachusetts; Chicago, Illinois; London, United Kingdom; New York, New York; Dublin, Ireland; and across Ontario, Canada. For more information, visit hornblowercorp.com.

Position Summary:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive strategy and execution for the technology behind Sales and Service at Hornblower. While you own the platforms the Sales, Service, and Contact Center teams sell and serve on, those teams own their operations and their people. This role is the IT-side product owner for the Sales & Service organizations, where you will serve as a peer to your Sales-org and Marketing-org counterparts. In this role you will need to land outcomes through partnership while leading through influence. On the Sales side you own the technology for every non-web channel — contact center sales, group and event sales, partners and third parties, and OTA bookings. On the Service side you own service technology for every channel, web and OTA included, from pre-booking inquiry through post-booking support. Web sales itself sits with the Digital team — because the guest journey crosses that line constantly, you'll partner closely with Digital wherever their surface and yours meet.The problems aren't fully framed yet, the stakeholder map is wide (Sales, Contact Center, Marketing, Digital, plus vendors like Anchor and Salesforce and several consultancies), and the right answer generally isn't sitting in anyone's backlog. You'll shape it as the first dedicated product owner for this scope, in close partnership with the Head of Product.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Drive the enterprise roadmap for Sales and Service technology, framing the problems worth solving and sequencing the bets across channels, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Shape the technology strategy and the measurement approach behind it — define what good looks like for non-web sales (contact center, group/event, partners, OTA) and for cross-channel service, and the metrics we'll hold ourselves to.
  • Navigate the internal-and-vendor stakeholder map and lead without authority to a single coherent plan people can commit to.
  • Partner closely with the Digital team at the web/non-web seam — Digital owns the web sales surface, you own everything else in sales and all of service, and the guest journey crosses that boundary constantly. Make the seam invisible to the guest.
  • Influence senior partners across IT and the business to make the contested tradeoffs — build vs. buy, vendor vs. internal, sales-channel-specific vs. shared service capability — and own the rationale behind those calls.
  • Partner with engineering and vendor teams on architecture tradeoffs across a multi-platform ecosystem; bring a clear technical point of view to decisions about Anchor, Salesforce, and the integrations between them.
  • Drive execution against the roadmap across multi-quarter horizons, sequencing near-term wins in contact center, group/partner sales, OTA, and cross-channel service so they compound into the longer-arc strategy.

What success looks like (first 6–12 months)

Every day, the world's most mission-critical companies — banks, hospitals, governments, and Fortune 500 enterprises — run on Salesforce. And every day, the teams behind those orgs face a choice: move fast or stay safe. At Flosum, we refuse that tradeoff. As the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, data, and security platform, we empower teams to ship fearlessly, recover instantly, and govern with confidence — all without leaving the platform they love.

We're looking for a visionary product leader who sees what's possible when innovation and trust live in the same place. Someone who wants to leave a fingerprint on an entire ecosystem.

The Opportunity

This is more than a product role — it's a chance to architect the operating system for the modern Salesforce enterprise. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a platform that touches release managers at sunrise, developers at midnight, and CISOs every minute in between. You'll lead a passionate team of product managers, partner shoulder-to-shoulder with brilliant engineers, and sit at the table with customers solving problems that matter — from accelerating releases by 10x to recovering an org in minutes after a catastrophic event.

If you've ever wanted to build the category-defining product in Salesforce DevOps, this is your moment.

  • Set the North Star. Craft a bold, multi-year product vision that anticipates where Salesforce — and the AI-powered enterprise — is heading next, from Agentforce to Data Cloud and beyond.
  • Build the team that builds the future. Recruit, mentor, and inspire a world-class product organization across DevOps, data management, and security — a team people fight to join and never want to leave.
  • Obsess over customers. Sit with admins, developers, release managers, and security leaders. Understand their 2 a.m. anxieties and their 10 a.m. ambitions. Turn those insights into products they'll champion.
  • Ship things that matter. Drive the full lifecycle — from messy whiteboard to flawless launch — for capabilities like Git-based version control, AI-assisted code review, intelligent backup & recovery, and zero-trust security.
  • Stay ahead of the platform. Turn every Salesforce release into an opportunity, not a fire drill, ensuring Flosum is always first and always native.
  • Win the category. Outthink and outmaneuver every competitor by knowing the market deeper than anyone else and telling a story only Flosum can tell.
  • Be a force multiplier. Partner with marketing, sales, success, and AppExchange & SI partners to turn great products into great businesses.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • A product leader with 10+ years of experience and the scars and wins to prove it — including 3+ years building and leading PM teams.
  • A Salesforce native at heart — you dream in metadata, you've debugged a deployment at midnight, and you know why governor limits exist (and how to live with them).
  • A builder who has shipped DevOps, ALM, data protection, or security products that customers genuinely love.
  • A strategist who can paint the 5-year picture and an operator who can ship next Tuesday.
  • A storyteller comfortable in front of a single customer, a packed room, an analyst, or a board.
  • A magnet for talent and a champion of the people you lead.

Bonus Superpowers

  • Deep fluency in Git, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), and modern developer workflows.
  • Experience with backup, archival, sandbox seeding, and data masking at enterprise scale.
  • Battle-tested in regulated environments — SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR.
  • A point of view on how AI will reshape the Salesforce admin and developer experience — and the chops to ship it.
  • Salesforce certifications, an engineering background, or an MBA that sharpens your edge.

What Success Looks Like

  • One year from now, you will have published a roadmap the entire ecosystem talks about, built a team that's the envy of the industry, and shipped releases that move ARR, expand customer relationships, and cement Flosum as the undisputed leader on the AppExchange. Five years from now, you'll look back at a category you helped define — and an enterprise software movement you helped lead.

Job Summary

The Vice President (VP) of Finance is a key member of Centerstone’s financial leadership team, reporting directly to the Chief Accounting Officer (CAO). The VP of Finance provides strategic financial leadership, analytical insight, and operational oversight across the organization’s financial planning, analysis, and reporting functions.

This role partners closely with the CAO, CFO, and other senior leaders to drive financial excellence, optimize performance, and support data-informed decision-making across all markets and service lines. The VP of Finance will play a critical role in aligning financial strategies with Centerstone’s mission, vision, and long-term growth objectives.

Essential Job Functions

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Partner with the CAO and CFO to define and execute financial strategies that support Centerstone’s strategic goals, mission delivery, and sustainable growth.

  • Provide expert guidance and analysis to senior leadership to support organizational decision-making, forecasting, and resource allocation.

  • Lead development of multi-year financial plans and long-range forecasts to ensure fiscal sustainability and mission alignment.

  • Support the CAO in maintaining a strong internal control environment and compliance with all financial regulations, accounting standards, and audit requirements.

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  • Oversee the preparation, consolidation, and analysis of annual budgets and forecasts in collaboration with operational and regional leaders.

  • Develop and refine key financial metrics and performance dashboards to monitor operational performance and identify improvement opportunities.

  • Lead ongoing variance and trend analyses to provide actionable insights on revenue, expenses, and capital utilization.

  • Drive financial modeling and scenario planning to support strategic initiatives and market expansion efforts.

Operational & Market Support

  • Partner with Market Presidents, State CEOs, and operational leaders to provide financial guidance and support decision-making at all organizational levels.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor on pricing, cost structure, service line profitability, and capital investments.

  • Ensure financial processes and reporting align with operational goals and provide transparency across markets and departments.

Accounting & Compliance Collaboration

  • Work closely with the CAO and accounting teams to ensure accuracy and integrity in financial statements and reporting.

  • Support compliance with GAAP, state and federal regulations, and organizational accounting policies.

  • Partner in the development of accounting policies and procedures that ensure efficiency, consistency, and compliance across the enterprise.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Promote a culture of transparency, integrity, and fiscal responsibility throughout the finance function.

  • Encourage professional development and career growth within the finance and accounting departments.

Performance Improvement & Systems

  • Lead initiatives to streamline financial processes, enhance use of technology, and strengthen data integrity across financial systems.

  • Evaluate and implement best practices to improve efficiency, accuracy, and reporting capabilities.

  • Support integration of financial systems following mergers, acquisitions, or organizational restructuring.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Healthcare experience

  • Multi-state operations experience

  • Strong leadership and team-building skills with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.

  • Deep understanding of healthcare finance, reimbursement, cost management, and financial reporting.

  • Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Demonstrated expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

  • Advanced proficiency in financial management systems and tools (ERP, reporting platforms, Excel).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-financial leaders.

  • High degree of integrity, confidentiality, and professional judgment.

Experience and Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field required.

  • Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or related) or CPA designation strongly preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, preferably within healthcare, behavioral health, or nonprofit sectors.

  • Proven experience leading financial operations in multi-entity or multi-state environments.

  • Demonstrated success working within complex organizational structures with shared services or matrixed reporting.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Directly supervises finance leaders and analysts as designated by the Chief Accounting Officer.

  • Provides leadership, direction, and professional development opportunities to all team members.

  • Collaborates with accounting, operations, and executive leadership to ensure cohesive financial performance across the organization.

Employee benefits package: full-time employees receive health, dental, vision, retirement, life, & more

Welcoming, warm, supportive: a work culture & environment that promotes your well-being, values you as human being, and encourages your health and happiness

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the company

Our client is an FDA-registered and ISO 17025 accredited independent contract microbiology laboratory providing essential testing and research services across a diverse range of industries. Based in the United States, the team serves global leaders in the pharmaceutical, medical device, cosmetic, and food sectors. By leveraging decades of expertise in ASTM, AOAC, and USP standards, they help partners verify product efficacy, ensure safety compliance, and support innovative marketing claims through rigorous scientific analysis.

Job Summary

As an Account Manager, you will serve as the strategic bridge between our clients and our laboratory operations. This is not a standard customer support role; we are looking for a commercially-driven, relationship-focused professional who can navigate the complexities of a technical, scientific, and highly regulated B2B environment. You will be responsible for ensuring client satisfaction, driving high retention rates, and identifying growth opportunities within your portfolio. If you are a calm, highly organized communicator who thrives on managing multifaceted projects and maintaining long-term trust with sophisticated stakeholders, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, managing expectations and laboratory timelines with precision.
  • Own the commercial health of your accounts, including responsibility for renewals, retention, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).
  • Proactively identify opportunities for cross-selling and account expansion by understanding client needs and technical requirements.
  • Coordinate multiple active projects simultaneously, ensuring seamless communication between the client and the internal technical team.
  • Handle account escalations with empathy and professionalism, resolving issues while maintaining the long-term integrity of the partnership.
  • Maintain meticulous records within HubSpot to track client interactions, project status, and revenue forecasts.
  • Monitor key performance indicators such as reorder rates, logo churn, and client satisfaction scores.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, or Client Relationship Management.
  • Proven track record in a technical, scientific, or highly regulated B2B services environment (e.g., Clinical, Engineering, or Complex Manufacturing).
  • Demonstrated experience with commercial accountability, specifically in managing renewals or driving account growth.
  • High proficiency in HubSpot for managing pipelines and client data.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts accurately.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without sacrificing quality.
  • Professional stability and a proactive approach to problem-solving and client retention.
  • Willingness to work US Central Time (CT) hours with a minimum 7-hour overlap between 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Direct experience in Life Sciences, CRO/CDMO, or laboratory services.
  • Previous experience using LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems) or sample-tracking software.
  • Experience managing enterprise-level or multi-site accounts with complex decision-making chains.
  • Background in managing scientific services or high-stakes technical projects.

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

Job Description: Power BI Financial Analyst

Constellation seeks a Power BI Developer Financial Analyst to join our Homeland Security Team in Washington, DC. This role requires advanced dashboarding and data analysis skills. The analyst will design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that integrate operational and financial data to create meaningful, actionable insights for stakeholders. This role requires a strong understanding of SQL and coordination with other developers for extraction, transformation, and loading of data. This position is client-facing and requires excellent communication to translate complex technical outputs into clear business value.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards, reports, and data models using Power BI and other visualization tools.
  • Design, build, and maintain data ETL pipelines from sources such as SQL databases, SharePoint, and Excel.
  • Track, monitor, and reconcile program budgets, spend plans, obligations, and expenditures, providing regular financial status updates to leadership.
  • Collaborate with end users and technical resources to understand and integrate data outputs into visualizations effectively.
  • Translate complex data findings into clear, digestible insights for stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reports and dashboards.
  • Ensure compliance with DHS/CBP financial policies, procedures, and reporting requirements.

The ideal candidate must have the following experience, background, and credentials:
  • At least 4 years of experience working with large datasets in a Data Visualization tool like Power BI, Tableau, Qlik.
  • Bachelor’s degree is required, with major in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in program financial management, budgeting, or acquisition support for government programs.
  • Advanced understanding of SQL including query optimization, common table expressions (CTEs), and complex joins for deep-dive analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel for standard data analysis tasks (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, complex formulas).
  • Support strategic financial projects, including the development of tools, dashboards, and reports to improve visibility into financial management activities.
  • Prepare financial briefings, reports, and recommendations for senior executives and stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to gather requirements, present solutions, and translate complex data findings into clear insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience developing PowerApps and Power Automate solutions is preferred.
  • Experience using SAP is preferred.
  • Be a U.S. citizen able to pass a background investigation by the client agency. DHS clearance with CBP or DHS preferred.

Work Location: Remote

  • Experience in program financial management, budgeting, or acquisition support for government programs: Minimum 5 years (Required)

This position is 100% remote. The hours are 10am-7pm MST and includes one Saturday a month from 8-5 MST.

ABOUT US
The Savings Group (TSG), the parent company of RateGenius, AUTOPAY and Tresl, is the most diversified consumer marketplace for automotive finance, refinance, and protection plans. Through a network of more than 180 lenders across all 50 states, TSG provides consumers more choices for their origination and refinanced auto loans, while also delivering loan volume growth to its lender network and partners through a proprietary, web-based platform.

Why Work at The Savings Group?
Working at TSG is more than your standard J-O-B. That's because we work with some of the most amazing goal-oriented and driven people in fintech and still embody the spirit of a startup! Not only have we worked together to perfect the way we serve our customers, but we've built a pretty awesome culture in the process. Our people come from all kinds of backgrounds to create something exciting and new: A BETTER WAY TO DO CAR LOANS. We offer steady growth, a strong and supportive leadership team, and in-depth training and tools to ensure your success.

SUMMARY
The Customer Success Representative Level II ensures that customers who have completed an auto refinance or purchase loan had a positive experience. Customer Success maintains all overflow through TSG phone systems and is the resolution point for escalations within TSG and all its brands. Customer Success Representative Level II is required to respond to all complaints and escalations from start to finish and only escalate further if appropriate. Customer Success maintains Legal and Compliance concerns through QA processes.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include achieving positive results in the following key areas:

  • Understand and demonstrate principles of The Savings Group’s Mission, Vision, and Values.
  • Document all accounts, contact, and activity information into various systems.
  • Answer calls from internal and external sources, while providing a world-class customer service experience. Manage inbound and outbound communication by email, phone and/or text to customers and Lenders or previous lien holders. Including de-escalation of phone calls without transferring to ASM’s
  • Consistently respond to auto finance inquiries in a timely, efficient, and professional manner.
  • Outreach all funded loans within one business day via phone/email Contact customers who have completed a funded loan and assess their experience.
  • Quality Assurance – Listen to calls made by loan specialists at rate of 1 call per week per loan specialist and complete compliance checklists to ensure compliance guidelines are followed.
  • Voicemail response internal and external TSG Departments
  • Work inbound email boxes (Save/Sales). Follow up via phone call when necessary for escalated customers?
  • Research and resolve Short Payoff Issues to ensure loans are fully paid off.
  • Grade customer experience with tools provided – both on the customer’s experience and on the Loan Specialist who assisted them in completing the loan.
  • Provide responses to customers who left reviews on their auto loan experience via Podium/Birdeye or other lead sources.
  • Work Regulatory/BBB Complaints
  • Lien Holder Verification for LOS
  • RCA - Compile data received from the call such as a log of complaint reasons, escalations when necessary, and any relevant information.
  • Cancellations Inbox and responses
  • Unwinds/Issues – Chase funds
  • Lien Holder Verification for LOS/NetSuite add
  • Additional duties as required.
QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Education: Associate or bachelor’s degree required.
  • Experience: Experience in inside phone sales, telemarketing, quality assurance or customer service experience with auto finance companies or car dealerships.
  • Language/Communication/Interpersonal: Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills. Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence. Ability to effectively present information to customers, clients, and all levels of management.
  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to calculate figures, proportions, and percentages.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Analytical: Detail-oriented with ability to organize, prioritize and work independently. Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Technical: Ability to toggle between applications on a dual monitor setup. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, with intermediate Excel ability, required. Keyboarding/computer skills, heavy computer and phone usage.
  • Other: High level of personal motivation, professionalism and integrity required. Ability to exercise discretion and judgment. Must be dependable.
BENEFITS
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • Supplemental Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

Change of tasks, performing multiple tasks simultaneously, working with others as part of a team, and irregular schedule/overtime may be required at times.

MACHINES, TOOLS, AND EQUIPMENT

Become a part of our caring community

The Program Delivery Lead serves as a key partner to the VP of Commercial & Government Specialty, AD, Strategy Advancement and senior leadership team, driving strategic alignment, executive communication, division operations, event support and business planning. This role blends high level strategic advisory with hands on execution, ensuring leadership is equipped with clear insights, compelling materials, and coordinated plans to effectively run and grow the business. This role will lead the strategic design and narrative direction of Commercial & Government Specialty ensuring all programs align with organizational priorities and business goals.

This role leads the development of executive materials including board presentations, strategy memos, and business reviews, while providing actionable insights through analysis of business performance, market trends, and competitive intelligence. Additionally, the Program Delivery Lead supports divisional meetings and events, facilitates cross functional collaboration, and serves as a trusted advisor to leadership to enable informed decision making and execution of key priorities.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities:

  • Executive Communications & Leadership Support
    • Lead the development of executive level communications and materials for the VP of Commercial & Government Specialty in coordination with the AD, Strategy Advancement and senior leaders, including Board presentations, Strategy memos, Weekly Updates, Monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR/MOR), Executive briefings and rapid response materials
    • Ensure all content is clear, concise, and aligned to enterprise strategy and messaging.
    • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively prepare insights and materials for key discussions.
    • Provide perspective on risks, opportunities, and strategic choices to inform leadership decision making.
    • Drive organizational execution and accountability through effective business cadence management, including agenda development, follow up tracking, action planning, and facilitation of divisional, leadership, and offsite meetings to ensure alignment and decision making.
    • Act as a central coordination point to align priorities, messaging, and deliverables.
    • Prepare tailored materials and insights for a variety of leadership audiences and forums.
    • Coordinate business readiness efforts, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and equipped to execute against evolving priorities
  • Strategic Planning & Initiative Management – Government & Commercial Specialty
    • Partner with business management and strategy teams to coordinate:
      • Annual planning cycles
      • Goal setting and performance alignment
      • Strategic review processes
    • Track and monitor progress against KPIs, key strategic initiatives, identifying risks and ensuring accountability.
    • Deliver regular updates and report to leadership on initiative status and outcomes.
    • Use business intelligence and reporting tools to monitor, analyze and communicate performance indicators (KPIs).
    • Lead cross-functional business initiatives by coordinating execution across key partners (e.g., Network, Delivery COE, Underwriting, Finance, Compliance, HR, and Actuarial), ensuring deliverables align with strategic priorities, operational objectives, and timelines.
  • Division Operations & Event Support
    • Support planning and execution of divisional events, leadership meetings, and offsites.
    • Coordinate logistics with executive assistants and stakeholders, ensuring seamless execution and clear communication.
    • Serve as the business side counterpart to the event operations team, ensuring strategic alignment and seamless execution of events and programs.
    • Prepare materials and messaging to support effective leadership forums.
    • Work closely with executives, cross-functional partners, and content owners to craft compelling presentations and guide speakers in delivering clear, impactful messages.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Coordination across Government & Commercial Specialty.
    • Facilitate strong relationships between business leaders and key partners.
    • Act as a central coordination point to align priorities, messaging, and deliverables.
    • Prepare tailored materials and insights for a variety of leadership audiences and forums.
    • Coordinate business readiness efforts, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and equipped to execute against evolving priorities.

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Travel Necessary based on business needs

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • PMP certification a plus
  • Six Sigma Certification also a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business problems and translate insights into actionable content recommendations.

  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to guide teams toward clear objectives and cohesive content.

  • Experience designing content, agendas, and strategic narratives.

Unitek Learning is seeking an Executive Admissions Representative for our Cross-state enrollment team. This position is 100% remote, must be able to work 10a-7pm PST hours. The ideal candidate will have admissions experience, preferably within a nursing, healthcare, or higher education setting. Experience with student recruitment, enrollment processes, and relationship-building is strongly preferred.

Job responsibilities:
The expectation is that the majority of an Executive Admissions Representative time will be spent
directly interacting with prospects/students either in person or on the phone. It is also expected that
the Admissions Representative meet all minimum standards outlined per the performance

management program.

Prospect/Student Interaction (90%).
Building Relationships
• Take inquiry calls from all potential students interested in knowing or receiving
information about the programs—including entrance requirements, curricula, and
academic standards—and encourage qualified prospects to schedule an appointment for

an interview.

• Return web inquiries and calls promptly to all potential students and give accurate
information about the programs, including entrance requirements, curricula, and
academic standards.
• Make outbound phone calls to potential students that have expressed interest in
attending the institution. Outbound calling efforts are a key component of this role.
• Participation in organized phone-a-thons and dialing campaigns according to company
best practices is required and is an essential part of day-to-day activity.
• Initiate unsolicited leads and generate new business when not responding to outstanding
inquiries or working with current prospective students.
• Follow up on all inquiries that fail to schedule or show for an interview.
• Follow up interviews that did not progress in the enrollment process and
dropped/cancelled students to resolve any issues or address concerns.
Interviews
• Schedule and conduct student interviews, wherein any reference to Financial Aid complies
with the stated Company Policy.
• Utilize only approved company materials during the interview process, and conduct
interviews according to the stated policies and process at all times.
• Meet with the potential students to explain the program offering and match the college’s
benefits and advantages to the student’s needs. Discuss and advise suitable programs in
accordance with the student’s desires, qualifications, and objectives.
• Make all efforts to ensure that admissions management meets with the potential student
and is well informed about the student’s motivations and concerns about attending the

college.

Mentoring and Guidance (5%)
• Provide basic information and routine advice, guidance and assistance to students using
established procedures and policies on available programs and eligibility requirements,
including the application of policies, procedures and documentation regarding the

admissions process.

• Serve as a liaison between student and campus, and make all necessary enrollment forms
available and assist in completion as needed (including reviewing applications and related
documentation for compliance, partnering with Finance to ensure a high level of customer
service during the transition, and following up to ensure that financial aid packaging is
complete).
• Mentor and advise students to help them identify their unique skills and interests.
• Address any easily resolved inquiries, questions, concerns or issues (may refer more
difficult issues to a more experienced staff member), and ensure appropriate action is
taken to the satisfaction of the student, Company, and/or regulatory agencies in
compliance with policy, procedures and legal requirements.

Administrative (5%)
• Accurately account for all inquiries and the admissions activity associated with all

Inquiries.

• Complete daily activity reports.

• Ensure that all pre-start paperwork is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
• Keep all required reports current and accurate, including information stored in the system.
• Attend and successfully complete all training for this position, as required at any time by
the Company.
• Perform other duties as assigned by local leaders.
• Attend meetings as directed by supervisor.

Key Behaviors
• Dependability: Responds to requests for service and assistance.
• Teamwork: Balances team and individual responsibilities.
• Decision Making: Displays willingness to make decisions.
• Communication: Effectively communicates with others.
• Time Management: Can complete all job requirements in allotted time.
• Work Ethic: Displays an organized and result-oriented approach, and motivation to

perform without extensive direction.

• Accuracy: Displays high quality of work and level of accuracy.
• Performs other duties as assigned.
• Comply with all policies and standards.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • One (1) year internal hire: as a Senior Admissions Representative required or Two (2) years external hire: minimum of customer service, telemarketing, or sales required.
  • Demonstrated ability to fulfill Company Key Behaviors.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Ability to work assigned/flexible hours necessary to complete the job on a weekly basis

We Offer:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment
  • 2 Weeks’ starting Vacation per year. Increasing based on years of service with company
  • 12 paid Holidays and 2 Floating Holiday
  • 401k with company match
  • Company Paid Life Insurance at 1x’s your annual salary
  • Leadership development and training for career advancement
  • Tuition assistance and Forgiveness for you and your family up to 100% depending on the program

As a leading healthcare education organization, Unitek Learning’s family of schools helps thousands of students launch and accelerate their careers every year. As a rapidly growing and highly successful company, Unitek is also a great place to pursue a rewarding and challenging career. We offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, unlimited growth potential, and a collegiate work environment.

We're looking for a Senior SRE to join our team and help us build and maintain reliable, observable, and scalable infrastructure. You'll work closely with developers, own reliability practices, and contribute to the team's DevOps culture.

Requirements

Must Have: Technical Skills

  • Linux — confident troubleshooting in terminal, logs, processes, networking basics, resource usage.
  • Kubernetes / GKE — strong hands-on understanding of workloads, pods, services, ingress/gateway, probes, RBAC, resources, autoscaling, and troubleshooting.
  • GCP — practical experience with cloud infrastructure, especially around GKE, IAM, networking, load balancing, artifact registry, and production diagnostics.
  • Docker / Containers — images, registries, runtime debugging, container lifecycle.
  • Helm — understands Helm releases, values, deployment state, and rollback.
  • GitOps / FluxCD — able to understand and troubleshoot GitOps deployment flow, drift, image automation, and Git-based rollback.
  • CI/CD understanding — can investigate failed pipelines and deployment issues; does not need to be the main pipeline builder if DevOps owns that.
  • Observability — Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana; understands metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and production monitoring.
  • Networking fundamentals — DNS, load balancers, ingress, gateways, TLS, routing, firewall/security rules.
  • SLI / SLO / SLA — can define and apply reliability targets, not just explain the terms.
  • Incident response — experience with production incidents, rollback, service recovery, RCA/postmortem.
  • Databases / messaging operational basics — PostgreSQL, Couchbase, Kafka, Elasticsearch/ELK or similar; enough to monitor health, migrations, indexes, topics, and failure signals.
  • Security / compliance basics — secrets, IAM/RBAC, audit trail, release/change evidence.

Must Have: Reliability / Operational Skills

  • Can assess if a release is technically safe to proceed.
  • Can define what should be monitored during and after deployment.
  • Can verify production health after release.
  • Can prepare or validate rollback plans.
  • Can lead or support post-release watch.
  • Can improve runbooks and incident response procedures.
  • Can identify gaps in dashboards, alerts, deployment checks, and release evidence.
  • Can work with DevOps without duplicating their ownership.

Must Have: Soft Skills

  • Ownership and accountability — follows production issues through to closure.
  • Calm under pressure — can operate clearly during incidents, failed deployments, and rollbacks.
  • Clear communication — gives concise updates: impact, current action, ETA, risk, decision needed.
  • Structured troubleshooting — breaks issues down by app, infra, network, database, config, release diff, external dependency.
  • Risk awareness — can say when a release is risky and explain why.
  • Collaboration — works well with Dev, QA, Product, Support, Release Manager, and DevOps.
  • Documentation discipline — maintains runbooks, rollback steps, incident timelines, and operational evidence.
  • Blameless mindset — focuses on root cause and prevention.
  • Proactivity — finds missing alerts, dashboards, runbooks, and process gaps before incidents.
  • Prioritization — separates real production impact from alert noise.

Nice To Have

  • Terraform / IaC experience.
  • Advanced GCP infrastructure design.
  • ArgoCD or other GitOps tools.
  • Advanced database or performance tuning.
  • Service mesh experience.
  • On-call rotation experience with PagerDuty/Opsgenie or similar.
  • Experience facilitating RCA/postmortem sessions.
  • Betting/gaming domain experience.
  • Good written English for incident updates, release notes, and audit evidence.
  • Basic understanding of AI-related concepts: agents, skills, MCP.

Responsibilities

  • Own production reliability practices together with DevOps and engineering teams.
  • Monitor production health and improve observability.
  • Support releases, hotfixes, rollback, and post-release watch.
  • Validate deployment readiness and rollback readiness.
  • Participate in incident response and RCA/postmortem.
  • Maintain runbooks, dashboards, alerting rules, and operational documentation.

Vozy es una plataforma de voice AI que ayuda a las empresas a transformar la manera en que interactúan con sus clientes, a través de asistentes de voz contextuales e IA conversacional.

En Vozy tenemos una misión: transformar la forma en que las empresas se relacionan con sus clientes.

A QUIÉN ESTAMOS BUSCANDO

A alguien de marketing B2B que se haya curtido en la cancha de verdad. Que no le tema a la data fea, a los presupuestos ajustados ni a los cambios de rumbo. Alguien que haya construido o escalado un motor de demanda desde cero y que entienda, en carne propia, la diferencia entre "generar leads" y "generar oportunidades que cierran".

Agnóstico(a) en metodología, obsesionado(a) con los resultados. Si el mejor camino es PLG, lo toma. Si es outbound puro, lo ejecuta con precisión quirúrgica. Si es ABM con inbound de apoyo, lo orquesta. Lo que importa no es la metodología de moda, sino lo que funciona para este producto, este mercado y estos compradores.

Alguien con una mentalidad poco común: el rigor estratégico de un CMO combinado con el hambre táctica de un campeón de la ejecución. Y su superpoder: ver la IA no como una herramienta de moda, sino como un multiplicador de capacidad —en demanda, en operación y en escalabilidad—.

LO QUE HARÁS

  • Arquitectura de demanda: Sales-Led Growth como motor principal, con la capacidad de integrar PLG de forma táctica.
  • Construcción de pipeline: desde awareness hasta SQLs que cierran, no solo leads bonitos.
  • Posicionamiento y messaging: diferenciación clara en mercados competidos (especialmente AI/tech).
  • Alineación con Sales y Product: SLAs, sales enablement y ciclos de feedback que realmente funcionen.
  • Presupuesto orientado a ROI: cada dólar invertido en marketing tiene que ganarse su lugar.
  • Operativizar la IA: flujos automatizados, escalamiento de contenido e insights que aceleren la toma de decisiones.

LO QUE NECESITAMOS

  • 5-7+ años en B2B SaaS (preferiblemente AI/tech).
  • Experiencia comprobada en Sales-Led Growth (ABM, outbound, ciclos de venta complejos, respaldados con números).
  • Familiaridad con modelos PLG: entiende el pensamiento product-led, aunque su fuerte sea SLG.
  • Mentalidad AI-first: usa IA de forma pragmática hoy —en contenido, ops y analítica—, no como una aspiración a futuro.
  • Visión de negocio: entiende el marketing como generador de revenue, no como un área creativa.
  • Liderazgo cross-funcional: trabaja de forma efectiva con Sales, Product y Ops.

DIFERENCIADORES

  • Experiencia con un producto de IA conversacional o generativa.
  • Trayectoria escalando de Serie A a B+ con un equipo pequeño.
  • Experiencia en LATAM o mercados emergentes.
  • Resultados documentados: "usé IA para X y el resultado fue Y".

Cultura Vozy

En Vozy, la transparencia no es solo una palabra bonita: es nuestra forma de hacer las cosas. Mantenemos la información fluyendo de manera abierta y honesta, asegurándonos de que todos estemos en la misma página y remando hacia los mismos objetivos. Incluso en un mundo tech acelerado y en constante cambio, nunca perdemos de vista a las personas que impulsan nuestro crecimiento.

Somos un equipo 100% remoto. Nuestras herramientas async te permiten manejar tu tiempo de la manera que mejor te funcione, mientras que nuestras reuniones en vivo están enfocadas en conectar, decidir y avanzar juntos.

¡Y tenemos nuestras tradiciones! Somos muy respetuosos del tiempo de todos, así que si llegas más de un minuto tarde… te toca soltar un rap (o al menos hacer el mejor intento) 🎤

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Trabajo 100% remoto (contractor).
  • Vacaciones ilimitadas.

¿Sientes que no cumples con todos los requisitos?

En Vozy valoramos el potencial tanto como la experiencia. Si te apasiona lo que haces y tienes ganas de crecer, te animamos a postularte aunque no cumplas con cada requisito.

¡Podrías ser justo la persona que estamos buscando! 🙌

The Role

You will be working alongside another Assistant Management Accountant and reporting directly into the Financial Controller.

Ownership of the responsibilities below will be shared amongst the team. The exact split isn't fixed — it'll flex based on strengths, interests, workload, and what the business needs, and will evolve as you settle in. What matters more than who does exactly what is that the team works well together and covers its responsibilities.

Trust is a key value in our company and team culture. With us being based remotely, it is crucial that you are motivated by working in a team and intrinsically driven to perform to the highest standards you are capable of. What matters most is attitude, diligence, and a strong sense of ownership. We need someone who does what they say they will, flags problems early, has an appetite to learn and is genuinely glad to pitch in for a teammate without being asked. Care and pride in your own performance and a team-player mentality matter here more than your explicit experience.

What You'll Be Doing - (as shared responsibilities)

  • Initially supporting, and ultimately owning a 5 day month-end process end to end — this spans payroll journals and accruals, sales and commissions postings, bank and balance sheet reconciliations, OPEX accruals and prepayments, management accounts preparation, and preparing the finance slides and commentary used for the board deck
  • Preparing the departmental costs reporting file and variance analysis within 2 days of month end close
  • Supporting the Financial Controller with regulatory reporting requirements
  • Supporting the audit process: preparing working files, and responding to auditor queries and sample requests
  • Processing supplier payments and managing Xero and Airwallex payment flows
  • Processing customer refunds and employee expenses
  • Calculating local host payments — liaising with the Operations and Expansion teams and dealing with host queries
  • Assessing foreign currency requirements and booking forward contracts on a weekly basis to ensure sufficient currency is held to pay hosts
  • Cash management: monitoring balances and ensuring spare cash is held in interest-bearing accounts where appropriate
  • Preparing and filing VAT returns
  • Preparing payroll

Requirements

    • Recently qualified OR part qualified accountant in active study (ACCA/CIMA or equivalent)
    • Solid grounding in management accounting and finance operations
    • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment — organised, self-motivated, excellent time management skills
    • A genuinely positive attitude and willingness to pitch in wherever needed
    • High attention to detail and a diligent, thorough approach to the numbers
    • A strong team player who communicates frequently via Slack and supports colleagues without daily in-person contact
    • Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills
    • Growth mindset and an active propensity to suggest and make improvements to existing processes, systems and files through automation/AI

Benefits

The warm fuzzy feeling that comes with knowing you are making a huge difference to small independent businesses, local economies, communities and conservation around the world.

  • 38 days holiday per year (inclusive of public holidays) - to be used when you like.

  • Flexible hours setup (40 hours p/w for full-time roles) and a fully remote company.

Every application that makes it through is carefully read by a real member of the team.

We ask all candidates to have a short screening call with HR to ensure we're aligned on the key requirements and expectations from both sides before progressing to the next stage.
