raw.excerpt: Who We Are:At Wagepoint, we’re good people.  Sure, maybe we’re biased.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

At Wagepoint, we’re good people. Sure, maybe we’re biased. But that’s only because Wagepointers bring the best versions of ourselves to do some of the best work in our careers.

We’re an authentic team who bring our diverse backgrounds, ideas, experiences and cultures together to make payroll magic. Speaking of, we “pull rabbits out of hats” for thousands of small business owners across Canada who rely on our payroll software to pay their employees and process their payroll taxes. And we’re just getting started.

We’re growing and looking for more awesome people to join our merry band of misfits. We are looking for people who share our understanding that when it comes to our commitment to our customers: we mean business. Especially given that the consequences of getting payroll wrong can sometimes be dire.

If you are the kind of person who has always wanted to make a difference and be heard at work, Wagepoint will give you plenty of opportunity to do just that.

The Role at High Level:

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Platform Engineerwith strong experience operating production cloud systems.

You’ll play a critical role in evolving our platform maturity — improving reliability, scalability, developer experience, and security across a growing SaaS environment. You will act as a technical leader within Platform Engineering, reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager.

This role is well suited for someone who values continuous improvement, enjoys enabling others, and takes pride in making complex infrastructure simple, secure, and reliable.

What You'll Be Expected To Own:

  • Design and evolve our Azure architecture while supporting our legacy AWS footprint

  • Production ownership of Kubernetes (AKS) clusters, including upgrades, scaling, ingress, and secret management

  • Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across multiple environments

  • Secure, reliable CI/CD platforms for infrastructure, Kubernetes workloads, serverless services, and database deployments

  • Azure and AWS networking design (VNet architecture, segmentation, private endpoints, traffic flow)

  • Developer enablement through templates, documentation, and self-service tooling

  • Observability: metrics, logs, tracing, and actionable alerting

  • Secure access patterns including RBAC, managed identities, and database access controls

  • Production incident response and root cause analysis

  • Define and improve service reliability standards, including SLOs, SLAs, and resilience design patterns

  • SOC audit readiness and secure-by-design practices

  • Reducing technical debt and shifting from reactive firefighting to proactive design

  • Participate in an on-call rotation

What You Bring To The Table:

  • 6+ years in cloud infrastructure engineering (DevOps, Cloud Architecture, SRE), including at least 2 years in a Platform Engineer capacity

  • 2+ years hands-on Azure production experience including compute, storage, networking and serverless services.

  • Experience working in a SaaS product company

  • Advanced proficiency in Kubernetes and containerization (Docker, Helm), including managing and optimizing production clusters

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)

  • Experience designing and owning end-to-end CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps and/or GitHub), with GitOps mastery.

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing solutions using Azure-native tools and OpenTelemetry

  • Proven production incident response and leading troubleshooting efforts

  • Experience improving developer productivity through internal tooling and automation

  • Strong proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (e.g., Python, Bash)

  • Experience managing production databases (performance, scaling, backups, access control, resilience)

  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices and operating in regulated environments (SOC, fintech, payroll, healthcare)

  • A systems thinker accountable for production systems, collaborative in approach, and focused on enabling teams through automation and modern tooling.

Bonus points if:

  • Azure and/or AWS certifications

  • DevSecOps or SRE experience

raw.description:
About A-Players

A-Players is a premier service company that places high-performing Business Associates with early-stage US tech startups. We don't staff generalists — we match strategic operators with founders who need real execution capacity at the intersection of communication, business development, and client relationships.

Our BAs work directly with C-level executives, often becoming the founder's most trusted communication layer — the person clients, partners, and stakeholders actually hear from.

The Role

This is a client-facing Business Associate role. You'll be embedded with a US startup and work closely with a founder, C-level executive, or head of a function — depending on the placement. The work varies, but the through-line is the same: you represent someone else in interactions that matter.

Client-facing doesn't always mean calls. For some placements it means managing relationships over video and voice. For others it means owning the written communication layer entirely — drafting outreach, handling email threads, preparing proposals, sending updates. What makes it client-facing is that you're the person external stakeholders actually hear from, in whatever format the work requires.

You won't just be running operations. You'll be the voice behind relationships that drive revenue, retention, and trust. The operational side of the job — research, tracking, documentation, scheduling — you'll handle efficiently using AI. That frees your time for what AI can't replace: being human in conversations that matter.

Placements vary. Some BAs focus on customer success and account management. Others support sales pipelines and BD outreach. Some act as communication leads across multiple stakeholder groups. What's consistent: strong communication, commercial awareness, and the ability to represent someone else's vision with confidence.

What You'll Do

Client & stakeholder communication

  • Serve as the main point of contact with clients, prospects, or partners on behalf of the founder or functional lead

  • Draft and manage high-impact external communications — outreach, follow-ups, proposals, and updates — in the founder's voice

  • Run structured check-ins with clients to track satisfaction, surface issues early, and identify expansion opportunities

  • Handle internal communications across teams, keeping everyone aligned without creating noise

Business development & account support

  • Support sales and BD workflows — from lead qualification and outreach to pipeline tracking and follow-up coordination

  • Prepare client-facing materials: onboarding docs, one-pagers, campaign briefs, decks, and status reports

  • Identify upsell and expansion signals and flag them to the right people with context and recommendations

  • Coordinate reference requests, client introductions, and stakeholder meetings

Execution & operations (AI-assisted)

  • Use AI tools to handle research, documentation, drafting, and reporting — fast and accurately

  • Maintain lightweight CRM hygiene, trackers, and deal documentation so nothing falls through the cracks

  • Prepare pre-meeting briefs, competitive snapshots, and weekly summaries that give the founder full context before any conversation

  • Track committed follow-ups and keep stakeholders accountable to next steps

Founder & leadership support

  • Act as an extension of the founder's or functional lead's bandwidth — anticipating needs, preparing materials, and ensuring no important conversation gets dropped

  • Translate priorities into clear actions and follow through without hand-holding

  • Flag risks, blockers, and decisions early — with context, not just alerts

What We're Looking For

Communication & client skills

  • Strong written and verbal English (C1+) with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences — clients, investors, partners, internal teams

  • Proven experience in client-facing roles: customer success, account management, sales support, agency work, or similar

  • Comfortable representing someone else's voice and vision in both written and verbal communication

  • Naturally builds rapport and keeps relationships warm without over-engineering it

Commercial & strategic thinking

  • Understands how early-stage startups work — fast-moving, resource-constrained, high-stakes decisions

  • Commercially oriented: connects communication and relationship work to revenue outcomes and retention

  • Can synthesize information quickly and surface what actually matters, not just what's happening

Execution & AI proficiency

  • AI-operator mindset — actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Perplexity to do in minutes what would otherwise take hours

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable: manages multiple clients or workstreams without things slipping

  • Operates well in ambiguity — makes reasonable judgment calls and flags the rest

Tools & systems

  • CRM experience: HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar — comfortable managing contacts, pipelines, and deal documentation

  • Client materials: proficient in Google Slides, PowerPoint, or Canva — can put together clean, structured decks and one-pagers without design support

  • Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar) as a daily working environment

  • Nice to have: experience with outreach tools like Apollo or Instantly

A-Players Startup Training Program

Before your first client placement, every BA completes the A-Players Startup Training Program — a focused, self-driven program designed to give you a helicopter view of how US startups actually operate.

The program runs 1–2 weeks depending on your background. You'll work through real startup scenarios across ops, sales, marketing, and BD — not theoretical exercises, but the kind of situations you'll face with a real client. You'll have access to A-Players' internal knowledge base with proven playbooks, templates, and case studies, and you'll receive direct feedback on your work throughout.

The goal is simple: by the time you finish, you should feel genuinely prepared — not just onboarded. Strong performance in the program is what leads to your first client match.

What Being an A-Players BA Means

  • Remote-first work in a high-performing, globally distributed team

  • Performance-based growth with transparent salary and role reviews

  • Strong ownership culture — initiative, judgment, and impact are what move you forward

  • 20 paid vacation days + unlimited sick leave

  • Continuous learning through internal workshops, training, and access to our knowledge base

  • Access to premium tools

How We Hire

  1. Initial interview with the Team Lead

  2. Take-home test assignment

  3. In-depth interview with our CEO (for some candidates)

  4. Offer

  5. Reference check

Compensation depends on your experience and the results of your test assignment.

If you communicate well, move fast, and want to be at the center of how early-stage startups grow — we want to talk.

raw.description:
Har du erfarenhet av tredjepartsrevisioner och är intresserad av att arbeta som underleverantör för att förstärka upp vårt befintliga revisionsteam, vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig.

Rollen som revisionsledare skog - Underleverantör

Rollen omfattar revisioner hos våra kunder i olika verksamheter/branscher. Det är ett omväxlande arbete med mycket resor, där kunderna finns runt om i Sverige och Skandinavien men även i andra delar av världen. Vi söker underleverantörer inom exempelvis FSC och PEFC

Revisorer kvalificeras för standarder och specifika branschkoder baserat på erfarenhet, utbildning och intresseområden. Vi ser att du varit verksam inom olika verksamheter/branscher för att erhålla olika koder inom de standarder som du kvalificeras för.

Ansvarsområden för dig som revisionsledare omfattar revisioner, rapportering samt uppföljning av de förbättringsområden som har definierats under revisionerna. Vi är flexibla gällande din placeringsort då vi har kunder runt om i hela Sverige. Med andra ord har du som revisor hos oss stort inflytande över hur din arbetstid disponeras och hur mycket uppdrag du är intresserad av.

Som underleverantör har du sedan tidigare ett konsultbolag eller startar upp ett, för att sedan erhålla uppdrag från Intertek.

Vi erbjuder:

  • En internationell miljö
  • Möjlighet att påverka omfattning av uppdrag
  • Ett inkluderande team
  • Kvalificering inom de olika standarderna

Vem söker vi?

  • Du har akademisk utbildning inom relevant område – Skogsbruk / Skogsmästare / Jägmästare
  • Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom det relevanta området
  • Du har kännedom kring certifieringar, processer, ledningssystem
  • Har arbetat med revisioner, interna eller externa i tidigare roller.
  • Du kan kommunicera på Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  • Innehar körkort
  • Meriterande är om du genomfört en revisionsledarutbildning om 40 timmar – IRCA Lead Auditor Training mot ex. ISO9001:2015.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som person är du driven, pragmatisk, kreativ och lyhörd. Du är utåtriktad och kommunikativ samtidigt som du är van vid självständigt arbete. En god portion initiativförmåga är nödvändig för att klara rollen på ett bra sätt. Vidare har du framgångsrikt drivit och slutfört projekt där din förmåga att tänka övergripande prövats. Du kan skapa och bibehålla affärsrelationer samt har en stark professionell integritet.

Om Intertek

Med fler än 43 000 medarbetare världen över är vi är ett av de största företagen i vår bransch. I vårt dagliga arbete hjälper vi företag världen över att se till att deras produkter är säkra att använda och möter kunders och myndigheters krav på kvalitet och prestanda. Det gör vi genom att revidera deras processer, certifiera deras ledningssystem, granska deras leverantörer, prova, analysera och certifiera deras produkter, inspektera deras tillverkningsanläggningar och skeppningar och arbeta med rådgivning inom regulatoriska frågor, kemikalier och hållbarhet.

Varje dag strävar vi efter att hjälpa våra kunder att ha säkra och socialt ansvarsfulla produkter och tjänster – We bring quality and safety to life!

Har vi fångat ditt intresse?
Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Urvalet av ansökningar sker löpande och vi uppmanar dig därför att skicka ditt CV så snart som möjligt. Vi kan tyvärr inte hantera ansökningar via mail utan ansökan görs via länken.

Eventuella frågor besvaras av Jesper Nyman, Auditor Manager, .

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

We are looking for a Product Designer to join our dynamic and growing Product Design team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design for a product area — problem framing through wireframes, prototypes, detailed specs, delivery QA, and iteration for enterprise workflows used by lease administrators, portfolio managers, and facilities teams.

  • Run discovery with enterprise customers — interviews, usability tests, and workflow observation — and translate findings into design decisions that shape what gets built, not just how it looks.

  • Build design system foundations — identify reusable patterns, document components, and contribute to the Tango Design System alongside the Director of Product Design and other designers.

  • Modernize legacy enterprise UX — redesign workflows that work but frustrate, within real constraints: data models that can't change overnight, user habits with embedded muscle memory, and migration paths that don't break production.

  • Build and validate prototypes. Use AI-powered design and prototyping tools to create coded prototypes for user testing and ship design artifacts directly into the development pipeline.

  • Partner daily with Product Management, Engineering, QA, and Customer Success. Communicate design rationale to non-designers. Advocate for the user when it's uncomfortable.

  • Use AI-powered design tools as standard practice for research synthesis, design iteration, prototyping, and cross-team documentation.

About You:

  • 4+ years in product design with demonstrated work on complex B2B or enterprise products — multi-step, data-dense workflows with multiple user types and real operational consequences.

  • A portfolio that shows process, not just polish — research, problem framing, iteration, trade-offs, and outcomes. We need to see how you think.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and legacy systems — can define the problem when there's no brief, design within constraints you didn't choose, and make progress without waiting for perfect information.

  • Strong cross-functional partnership — explains design decisions to engineers and PMs without jargon, holds a position with evidence, and changes direction when the evidence points somewhere else.

  • Deep experience with enterprise workflow design — lease administration, facilities management, project management, or adjacent enterprise SaaS domains preferred. Consumer app portfolios won't translate.

  • Design system instinct — has identified patterns, documented components, or contributed to a design system. Understands why consistency matters across a product and has opinions about how to get there.

  • Proficiency in Figma and comfort working with AI-powered design tools for prototyping, research synthesis, and documentation.

  • Familiarity with modern design practices: continuous discovery, usability testing, and data-driven iteration.

  • Experience with internationalized products supporting multiple languages and regional markets is a plus. Tango's platform supports 26 languages across 140+ countries.

  • Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

What We Offer

We’re committed to creating an environment where you can thrive—professionally and personally. Our offerings include:

  • Competitive Compensation We recognize and reward your contributions with a salary package that reflects your value.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Including health, dental, and vision insurance, and generous paid time off to support your well-being.
  • Flexible Work Environment Whether remote, hybrid, or in-office, we support work arrangements that promote productivity and balance.
  • Inclusive & Collaborative Culture We foster a workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, teamwork is encouraged, and everyone has a voice.

Tango is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, parental status, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and patient-focused Medical Assistant to support a telehealth and care management program in a structured, high-volume outreach environment.

This role blends traditional Medical Assistant responsibilities with phone-based patient engagement. The majority of the shift will involve outbound patient outreach, appointment scheduling, and documentation; however, candidates must also be comfortable performing core clinical support duties in a remote setting.

This is not an in-clinic position. The work is conducted remotely and requires strong communication skills, efficiency, and comfort working within defined performance metrics.

Core Responsibilities

Patient Outreach & Scheduling

  • Conduct high-volume outbound and inbound patient calls during scheduled shift
  • Schedule Annual Wellness Visits and care management appointments
  • Provide professional patient education regarding preventive services
  • Meet daily outreach and scheduling performance targets

Medical Assistant Support Duties

  • Prepare charts for provider review
  • Ensure accurate documentation within the EHR
  • Support care coordination and follow-up activities

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain HIPAA compliance at all times
  • Accurately document all patient interactions in the EHR
  • Escalate clinical concerns to supervising providers as appropriate

What This Role Requires

  • Comfort making 50–80 patient calls per shift
  • Strong phone presence and ability to engage Medicare-aged patients
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, structured environment
  • Excellent multitasking and documentation skills
  • Professionalism and resilience when handling objections or voicemail-heavy outreach

Qualifications

  • Medical Assistant certification or equivalent healthcare experience required
  • Prior experience in a medical office, primary care, or care coordination setting
  • Prior call center experience strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with Epic, NextGen, or similar EHR systems preferred
  • Experience working with Medicare populations preferred

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote setting
  • Comfortable with performance metrics and call volume expectations
  • Detail-oriented and clinically accurate
  • Reliable and punctual for scheduled shift
  • Able to balance patient empathy with efficiency

About Aembit

Aembit is the Agentic AI and Workload IAM company. We build the identity and access management platform that secures how AI agents and workloads connect to enterprise systems. Just as human IAM solved the problem of user access, Aembit provides secretless, policy-based access for the non-human identities that drive the modern enterprise: applications, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and AI agents.

Founded by experienced cybersecurity entrepreneurs and backed by Okta Ventures, CrowdStrike's Falcon Fund, and Ballistic Ventures, we are a fully remote team building one of the most important infrastructure layers in modern security. Our platform supports MCP, A2A, OAuth, OIDC, SPIFFE, and more, spanning cloud, SaaS, and on-prem environments.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Technical Marketing Intern to build the AI engine behind our growth team. Reporting directly to the Director of Technical Product Marketing, you will sit at the intersection of technical storytelling and engineering. Your goal is to design and deploy AI-driven tools and automation workflows that help us scale how we educate the market on Workload IAM. We’ve already started, and you’ll help us accelerate.

This is a role for a builder. You will have a direct impact on GTM operations, shipping real tools that the team uses. You will also get daily 1:1 mentorship, with time set aside every day to review your work, refine your builds, and learn the strategy behind marketing in the NHI security space.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI agents for marketing and sales use cases using frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or similar tools
  • Create automation workflows that transform technical content (docs, whitepapers, webinar transcripts) into draft blogs, technical guides, and social content
  • Design internal research and competitive intelligence agents that help the team stay sharp on the market
  • Connect tools and data sources using Python and/or Node.js scripting and no-code/low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • Work with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) to design and iterate on prompts for specific marketing use cases
  • Identify manual workflows worth automating and take them from rough idea to working prototype
  • Document everything you build so it can be maintained and handed off after the internship

What We're Looking For

Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

As a Commerce brand, Feedonomics is a leading product feed management platform that helps brands, retailers, and agencies list and optimize products across top ecommerce channels worldwide. Feedonomics manages everything from onboarding to ongoing feed optimization, enabling our clients to scale faster with less effort. Feedonomics has earned a strong reputation for a full-service model and powerful technology—all rooted in a commitment to excellence.

This role is for a person who thrives at building and operating a high performing software engineering team and is passionate about empowering engineers to achieve the best work of their careers. Well respected by technical and non-technical individuals, this person is an influential leader, coach, manager, and engineer. This leader will need to balance: driving our aggressive product roadmap, improving the performance and stability of our system, introducing engineering best practices into the organization, and leading/mentoring other engineers.

What You'll Do:

Work closely with our engineering leaders to:

  • Build an open, positive and energized culture

  • Build, lead and hire a high-caliber team of software engineers

  • Drive our technical roadmap and direction of our stack

  • Lead and inspire your team and other engineers to build the best ecommerce products on the planet

  • Encourage innovation and foster an environment of continuous improvement

  • Ensure that technical decisions support our goals of quality, performance, scalability, reliability, availability and security

Management responsibilities:

  • Be both a highly technical hands-on coder and an effective people manager

  • Hold your own in technical discussion, be a subject matter expert and have strategic influence

  • Establish team objectives in alignment with business goals

  • Organize and facilitate regular 1:1’s with your team for coaching and mentoring

  • Execution of performance improvement plans for under-performers

  • Continued enforcement of best practices to improve engineering quality and efficiency

  • Establish a sense of urgency and direction; set expectations

  • Create and participate in an on-call rotation for incident management

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years experience in building systems in PHP, Go, Python, Typescript, Angular, Ruby, etc.

  • Think iteratively by breaking down problems into smaller, deliverable / deployable pieces.

  • Quality is the top priority.

  • Knowledge of gRPC, RabbitMQ, and familiarity with caching solutions

  • 2+ years managing engineering teams, including demonstrated track record of growing senior talent and building team structure from the ground up

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform or Cloud Computing desirable

  • Experience with relational database systems and external services integrations

  • Experience with backend and frontend (UI) development

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and leading sprint ceremonies.

  • Experience with SaaS platforms or Cloud Computing highly desirable

  • Solid UNIX / LAMP knowledge (ideally 2+ years working experience with PHP, MySQL, and Linux)

  • Prior experience at a commerce software company is a plus

  • Have an excellent ability to communicate and to coordinate

  • Will speak up when something just doesn’t feel right with productive feedback

  • Have excellent problem solving, critical thinking and debugging skills

  • Has strong bias to action and the drive to make a difference

  • BS degree required or higher degree in Computer Science or related technical field

(Pay Transparency Range: $164,800 - $247,200)

Compensation Transparency

The national base salary range for this role is posted above in this job post.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams.

Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution.

Inclusion and Belonging

At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about the Commerce team, culture and benefits at

Protect Yourself Against Hiring Scams: Our Corporate Disclaimer

Commerce, along with many other employers, has become the subject of fraudulent job offers to hopeful prospective job seekers.

Be advised:

Commerce does not offer jobs to individuals who do not go through our formal hiring process.

Commerce will never:

  • require payment of recruitment fees from candidates;

  • request personally identifiable information through unsanctioned websites or applications;

  • attempt to solicit money from you as part of the hiring process or as part of an employment offer;

  • solicit money to complete visa requirements as part of a job offer.

If you receive unsolicited offers of employment from Commerce, we urge you to be extremely cautious and avoid engaging or responding.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Principal Biostatistician to provide statistical leadership for oncology clinical development programs. This role will support Phase I–III clinical trials and contribute to regulatory submissions while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide statistical leadership for oncology clinical trials across multiple phases (Phase I–III).

  • Lead the development of statistical analysis plans (SAPs), protocols, and clinical study reports (CSRs).

  • Design and review statistical methodologies for efficacy and safety analyses.

  • Oversee analysis datasets (SDTM/ADaM) and TLFs in compliance with CDISC standards.

  • Support interim analyses, data monitoring committee (DMC) activities, and adaptive designs.

  • Collaborate with clinical development, data management, programming, regulatory, and medical teams.

  • Contribute to regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA) and respond to health authority queries (FDA, EMA).

  • Provide strategic input on study design, endpoint selection, and sample size calculations.

  • Mentor junior statisticians and provide technical guidance.

Qualifications

  • PhD or MS in Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field.

  • 8+ years (MS) or 6+ years (PhD) of industry experience in biostatistics.

  • Strong experience in oncology clinical trials.

  • Hands-on experience with survival analysis, time-to-event endpoints, and complex oncology study designs.

  • Proficiency in SAS and/or R.

  • Strong knowledge of CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM).

  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions.

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with adaptive designs and Bayesian methods.

  • Prior experience interacting with regulatory agencies.

  • Experience in immuno-oncology or hematology oncology.

The Application Process

Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step. Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.

Who will you be working for?

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology. The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.

Company Overview

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).

QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend.

Why Join QinetiQ US?

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview

Join us in our fast-paced support to the Space Development Agency (SDA). Recognized as the Department of Defense's constructive disruptor for space acquisition, SDA delivers space-based capabilities to the joint warfighter to support terrestrial missions through development, fielding, and operation of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA_. SDA capitalizes on a unique business model that values speed and lowers costs by harnessing commercial development to achieve a proliferated architecture and enhance resilience. We are seeking an Master Scheduler to support SDA’s mission. Responsibilities include:

Responsibilities

  • Support the PWSA Ground Program (PGP) Director and Ground & Launch Cell Director.
  • Retrieve, review, and consolidate ground schedules with ground segment contractors, the government, and across other contractors as needed.
  • Coordinate schedule inputs from multiple sources to develop and maintain a government-specific integrated master schedules (IMS).
  • Maintain cognizance of internal developments to inform scheduling updates and provide ground segment updates as needed.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, critical paths, schedule risks, and divergences; present findings to leadership.
  • Perform configuration management functions as directed by the government, to include review of deliverables to ensure contract compliance and on-time CDRL delivery.
  • Work with ground segment contractor counterparts to facilitate timely distribution to, review by, and feedback from SDA subject matter experts.
  • Develop internal briefing material and external-facing schedule products with high standards and attention to detail as directed by the government team.
  • Support product managers, coordinate cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders as needed (i.e. Government, Military, SETA, FFRDC, UARC, & Industry).
  • Provide general support to the SDA as tasked (e.g. coordinate meetings and briefings).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree with relevant experience
  • 5+ years developing integrated master schedules with Microsoft Project
  • 5+ years Project Management experience
  • Prior experience supporting space system development or the Department of Defense
  • Hands-on proficiency using Microsoft Office tools, principally Excel and Power Point
  • Excellent written and visual communication skills
  • Creative thinking skills
  • Ability to work in an extremely fast paced organization
  • TS with SCI eligibility;#qinetiqclearedjob

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EVM and associated contract efforts

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 25 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

The Sales Engineer lives and works in the intersection between sales and engineering. The ideal candidate must be able to articulate technology and product positioning at the executive, business and technical levels. Sales Engineers are the primary technical support for the sales force and are responsible for actively driving and managing the technology evaluation stage of the sales process. They are there to ensure success with all Harness customers and strategize with their sales counterparts to steer customers to a commercial relationship.

  • World class presentation skills in delivering presentations/demos of our platform
  • Able to work with customers directly to debug common errors
  • Ability to tie business problems to technical solutions
  • Capable of understanding and articulating technology value propositions
  • Drive complex technical engagements with customers to prove the value of Harness solutions

About You

  • You will be responsible for delivering a great product demonstration which tells a story of how our software provides value to our customer
  • You will be responsible for representing the product to customers and at field events such as conferences, seminars, etc.
  • You will remain knowledgeable and up-to-date on changes and developments on our technologies
  • You either actively develop software, have a prior background as a developer, or worked with developers in a DevOps role
  • Strong cloud knowledge, you worked with infrastructure automation such as Terraform
  • You are able to respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs
  • You are able to convey customer requirements to Engineering teams
  • You are able to travel throughout a sales territory with minimal restrictions and occasionally on short notice

Location

What You Will Have At Harness

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Quarterly Harness TGIF-Off / 4 days

This is not a training role. We’re hiring experienced acquisitions professionals who can take live seller leads and close deals from day one. If you’ve been doing this work, you know exactly what this job is. If you haven’t — this isn’t the right fit.

ABOUT US

We are a real estate wholesaling company that buys houses directly from homeowners nationally. Most deals we wholesale — the best ones we buy and flip ourselves with our own capital. Unlike most wholesalers, we can fund deals when it matters. This is not a brokerage and not a lead-gen middleman — we have real funding, real deal flow, and a real operation behind you.

Most of our leads are inbound or warm: PPC (Google Ads), Meta (Facebook), Pay-Per-Lead, Direct Mail, and niche lists (pre-foreclosure, tax delinquent, probate). You spend your time on real seller conversations, not chasing cold prospects.

We are a lean, fast-growing team building a focused acquisitions operation around fewer, stronger people instead of just adding headcount. You work directly with the founder — no corporate layers, no bureaucracy.

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT AND BETTER

  • We have our own capital to close — when a deal is too good to assign, we buy it ourselves. Your best deals don’t die because the company can’t fund them

  • AI-supported CRM with call recording, auto-transcription, and automated follow-up — you focus on sellers, the system handles the busywork

  • Structured pipeline with speed-to-lead automation — leads get to you fast, not stale

  • Small, focused team — you get real lead volume and real support, not a floor of 15 people fighting over scraps

  • Dispo and TC teams in place — your job is to acquire, not chase title companies or buyers

  • Multiple paid marketing channels with consistent lead flow — real investment in deal sourcing, not just cold lists

  • Direct access to the founder and decision-makers — no politics, no layers, fast answers

  • Family-oriented culture that values loyalty, direct communication, and long-term growth — not churn and burn

COMPENSATION

  • Ramp Period:$3,000–$5,000/month for the first 3 months (based on experience and interview)

  • Commission: 10% of gross assignment fee after ramp — 100% commission, no cap on earnings

  • Growth: Tiered commission structure for consistent top performers

First year approximate compensation:$80,000–$120,000+ between ramp salary and commissions. Top performers earn significantly more. We’re scaling the acquisitions team — people who prove themselves have a clear path to higher commission tiers, team leadership, and profit participation.

SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday. Choose one shift: 9 AM–6 PM EST or 10 AM–7 PM EST. Must be responsive for time-sensitive leads evenings and weekends.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2+ years in wholesaling acquisitions

  • Stable tenure in recent roles

  • Virtual closing experience strongly preferred. If your background is primarily in-person, you’ll need to demonstrate phone closing ability through a call recording or live role-play

  • Experience in a wholesaling company or as an independent wholesaling operator

  • Not currently running your own acquisitions business

  • Experience in real estate is required

  • Fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus

  • Remote-first role. If we introduce a hybrid model in the future, flexibility to work from the Fort Lauderdale area is a plus

  • Full-time commitment — no other active jobs or side businesses

Do not apply if: your experience is limited to brokerage, realtor work, or general sales; you have no wholesaling deal ownership; you’re looking for guaranteed salary beyond the 3-month ramp; or you cannot commit full-time to one role.

JOB SUMMARY

The QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.

The QA Specialist is responsible for the timely completion and overall completeness of a reviewer report. Completeness is determined by customer requirements, company best practices, and clinical accuracy. In addition, the QA Specialist participates in improving DS processes and works with the Manager to ensure high efficiencies are achieved.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Interaction

  • Provides regular report status updates to the client.
  • Evaluates the Quality of physician’s report and determines if the report will meet all client and jurisdictional standards; the QA Specialist is also responsible for ensuring that the clinical rationale supports the physician’s determinations.
  • Clarifies ambiguous report questions with clients.
  • Distribute final report back to client according to client specific requirements.
  • Receives, coordinates & executes all aspects of clarification & addendum requests from the client.
  • Participates in phone calls OR meetings with client(s) when a report is in question.
  • Follow up with the client for any missing information that is pertinent to the referral.

Physician Interaction

  • Works directly with physicians to ensure that all client questions are answered and supported by clinical rationale.
  • Conduct regular follow up with the physician or their office staff to ensure an on-time delivery of the report.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written feedback to the doctor regarding report quality.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written requests to the physician or their office staff for clarifications.
  • Receive written or verbal confirmation from the physician that a report has the doctor’s approval and ensures the doctor provides his/her signature for the final report.

Report Analysis

  • Review each physician report for data accuracy including spelling, grammar & punctuation.
  • Responsible for ensuring that all state requirements for reporting are met.
  • Responsible for report format and adhering to each client’s specific requirements.
  • Must ensure that all client special handling instructions with regard to report completion and delivery are met.

Additional Duties

  • May provide oversight to the work of the team members.
  • Continuously improves processes that help to facilitate better turnaround time, peer to peer success rates and lessens returned reports by clients for clarification purposes, ultimately resulting in higher client satisfaction.
  • Responsible for the final approval on cases for release to the client.
  • Will act as a liaison and coordinate quality issue reports along with all new reviewer reports with the VP of Clinical Operations.

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

An Associate’s Degree or Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Business experience in a healthcare and/or insurance setting is preferred.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. raw.description:
Dane Street is a leading provider of IME and Peer Review Services to the Disability, Workers’ Compensation, Auto, and Group Health marketplaces.

We are seeking a strong contributor to join our Disability National Account Management Team. The candidate must possess the right balance of relationship-building skills, problem-solving and analytical abilities, and business development experience to significantly impact Dane Street’s existing book of business.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

The National Account Manager is responsible for both retaining and expanding existing client relationships while also proactively generating new business opportunities through outreach, referrals and consultative sales efforts. This role combines strategic account management with business development to drive revenue growth.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The National Account manager will have the support of the entire organization to retain and grow Dane Street’s existing clients:

  • Identify and pursue new revenue opportunities within existing and new accounts
  • Working with Dane Street’s Director of Operations, QA Staff and Business Analyst team to ensure client satisfaction and effective problem resolution
  • Developing strong Manager/Requester and Senior Leadership relationships across Dane Street’s accounts
  • Generating strong goodwill within the existing account user base
  • Creating and executing a strategic account plan for all Dane Street clients
  • Growing revenue and referral volume within all top target accounts
  • Proactively identify risks and resolve client concerns
  • Conduct outreach to prospective clients through networking, referrals and targeted prospecting
  • Provide weekly reporting on account health, growth opportuniries and sales activities
  • Support special projects and cross-functional initiatives as needed

Requirements

The National Account Manager is responsible for all aspects of Account Management with Dane Street’s client base. An in-depth understanding of the Disability marketplace with LTD claims or clinical experience is strongly preferred.

This position reports to the Director, Disability Account Management.

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

An Associate’s Degree or Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Disability Claims experience in an insurance setting is preferred.

1 – 3 years in Account Management, Business Development, or client-facing sales roles.

Experience with outbound outreach, prospecting, or revenue generation strongly preferred

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, along with a strong sense of urgency to meet our clients’ expectations

Passionate customer service orientation

Ability to confidently initiate outreach and develop new client relationships

Excellent time management and attention to detail
Strong presentation and negotiation skills

Track record of client retention and revenue growth

Experience navigating web-based systems efficiently, including Google Docs

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.
